name: Cua Driver
summary: Cua Driver is an open-source computer-use driver from Cua that lets an agent inspect and operate native desktop apps and browsers on macOS, Windows and Linux. It speaks MCP over stdio and also ships a CLI and typed SDKs. Where the app and platform allow it, input is delivered in the background without moving the user's pointer or taking focus.
facts: MIT; optional perception extension is AGPL-3.0
MCP over stdio, CLI, typed SDKs
Hermes Agent (computer_use toolset), OpenClaw (experimental CUA provider)
goodFor: Desktop apps that have no API
Agent and user working on the same machine
Bringing your own agent and model
watchOut: Background input depends on app and platform support
The optional perception extension is AGPL-licensed
